issues: B1 (correctness, X4 consumer): pycore/pyctl/tts/laravel_audio_worker_state.py:566-589. build_local_task (audio_queue_center.py:138-148) no longer writes payload.md5 for a word without a Laravel md5. The lane worker's _normalize still fails such a task with 'word_audio payload carried no md5' (:588-589). As a result, every md5-less local word task that a word_audio lane worker pops is reported failed and never synthesized: the orchestration Part1 fill (orch_promote.py:57) and a manual promote without md5. Probe: _normalize(build_local_task('word_audio','en','Hello','orchestration')) returns that error. Fix: require md5 only for Laravel-sourced tasks. A task with _local_source and payload.cleaned_word goes on with md5 '', so kokoro_batch, save_to_cache and the ledger key it '<lang>:text:<cleaned_word>'. Keep the error for a Laravel task without md5.

B2 (correctness, retry poison): pycore/pyctl/tts/audio_resource_delivery.py:312-329. A word without a Laravel md5 now uploads with no md5, but no server resolves by cleaned_word yet: LDRI-11 is still open (items_wordnew.json, laravel-qyapp-D7), and AppQyV1WordMediaController.php:153-157 answers 400 'md5, lang and audio_base64 are required'. That lands in the RuntimeError branch (:328-329). RESOURCE_KIND has no permanent_error (register :62-72), so each such clip retries every 300 s at most, forever, on every server, including the local Laravel. Before this change the row ended in not_found or stored. Once LDRI-11 lands, the contract rejection WORD_NOT_FOUND must also end the row. Fix: when clip_md5 is empty, treat a 4xx rejection as terminal, except 408/409/425/429. That is the rule in laravel_audio_delivery._terminal_report_error, so share one helper instead of copying it. Return OUTCOME_DONE with a skip reason, the same as the batch path's no_target/invalid at :271-275. Prefer reading the rejection code from contract word_identity.fallback_when_md5_absent.rejection_code through a queue_center_contract accessor. That file is pycore-runtime's, so route the request through pycore-lead.

B3 (correctness, AOQSD-16 regression): pycore/pyutils/tts/word_audio_cache.py:200-216 (note_stored) with :192-197 (_lookup). note_stored now creates a mapping for a language that load_all has not installed yet, or before load_all starts. _lookup returns that partial mapping as if the language were loaded. lookup_many and find_cached_many then answer from the words stored so far and report every other cached word of the language as a miss, instead of returning None and falling back to the directory scan. Probe: storing 'salut' into an unloaded 'fr' makes a lookup of the on-disk 'bonjour' and 'merci' return only 'salut'. During the boot load, orchestration resumes at route registration and the lanes start right after the restore, so cached words are generated again. That is the AOQSD-16 failure, and it breaks lookup_many's 'None when not loaded' contract. Fix: keep stores for a language that is not installed in a pending map that _install merges (newest wins), and keep _lookup returning None for such a language. Create a live mapping from a store only after load_all has finished, which is the case of a language directory created after boot. Base that decision on a load-finished state, not on _loading.

RESTARTTRAY-03 residual (pre-existing): flush_dirty (audio_queue_center.py:846-866) is not gated on the restore. A lane can be mutated before its restore: orchestration resume can promote into Part1 before the boot chain's load_snapshot, or the lane's switch is OFF. The persister can then write the unrestored in-memory queue over the saved snapshot. Recommended: hold a lane's dirty state until its restore completes, or restore on first mutation.

Those clips keep uploading under that md5. Optional: rebuild orchestration and manual local word tasks through build_local_task at restore. Ledger rows cannot be told apart from the real md5 of a lower-case word, so leave them.

Cross-end (orchestrator, LDRI-11): the pycore keys lower-case the word, but the upload body (audio_resource_delivery.py:315) and the batch item (:266) send cleaned_word as the original-case text.
